overview: Frontier: Missile Horizon is a fully on-chain planetary warfare strategy game on the Internet Computer where players purchase land, accumulate tokens, and compete on a global hex-grid map.
features: Purchase hex land plots on a 10,242-tile interactive 3D globe
Accumulate and claim FRNTR tokens passively from owned land
Upgrade generators to increase token generation rate
Purchase survey reports to reveal detailed plot resource data
Complete missions for on-chain FRNTR rewards
Tamperproof on-chain audit log records every confirmation and cancellation with principal ID and timestamp
Confirmation modal required before every irreversible action
One-time post-action quick-nav toast after each completed transaction
Live treasury split dashboard showing developer, leaderboard, and liquidity pots
Admin panel with mint, reset, and audit log query tools
